name: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead
summary: In a trash-filled apartment, 24-year-old Akira Tendou watches a zombie movie with lifeless, envious eyes. After spending three hard years at an exploitative corporation in Japan, his spirit is broken. He can't even muster the courage to confess his feelings to his beautiful co-worker Ootori. Then one morning, he stumbles upon his landlord eating lunch—which happens to be another tenant! The whole city's swarming with zombies, and even though he's running for his life, Akira has never felt more alive!

One boy, clad in black robes with a white cane and sword strapped to his hip, approaches the prestigious school. This young man—Oliver—must form a bond with a katana wielding girl named Nanao if he's to survive the dangers he's to face at this school that is anything but what it seems

name: Knokke Off
summary: Follows a group of teenagers as they spend the summer at the Belgian seaside while searching for love, friendship and most importantly, for themselves.

name: MTV's Top Pop Group
summary: Year after year, supergroups like *NSync, the Backstreet Boys, the Pussycat Dolls, Danity Kane and the Jonas Brothers carve their place in pop music history. They sing. They dance. They entertain. They inspire. Now, the search is on to find the next big pop sensation. Yes, MTV is on a mission to discover the greatest untapped talent in America! After an extensive nationwide search, nine amazing groups hit the stage to compete for a $100,000 prize and the coveted title of MTV's Top Pop Group.

summary: Second year high school student Rakurou Hizutome is interested in one thing only: finding "shitty games" and beating the crap out of them. His gaming skills are second to none, and no game is too bad for him to enjoy. So when he's introduced to the new VR game Shangri-La Frontier, he does what he does best—min-maxes and skips the prologue to jump straight into the action. But can even an expert gamer like Rakurou discover all the secrets that Shangri-La Frontier hides...?

Le Havre meets with two friends and will tell that they had a plan that he has in prison: he realized that his life is very eventful and you can make a real interesting movie about it. Le Havre believes that his film about gangsters will be true, which means it will most likely be the most diverse.

summary: The series is about Olha, a 40-year-old woman who goes through a difficult life change when her husband leaves her for a younger mistress and spends all of the family's savings on gambling. Left with a bunch of debts, Olha is forced to return to work in a publishing house, from which she once refused for the sake of her family. Her life changes dramatically after a chance meeting with 26-year-old Dima, who takes her for his age.

name: Ухожу красиво
summary: A multi-part comedy action movie with Vladimir Yaglych about a policeman who, having learned that he does not have long to live, decides to show himself as a real hero. Oper Boris Fadeev was not distinguished by a special zeal for work - he always sought to avoid unnecessary tasks and evade responsibility. Problems in the family, alcoholism and poor mental health complicate his already difficult life, in addition, he learns about a hereditary disease, due to which he may soon die. Not wanting to die ingloriously, Fadeev, to the surprise of those around him, is transformed and begins to take on the most difficult cases, not at all caring about his safety. Boris is sure that he will be able to leave beautifully. Here's just one catch: no matter how hard he tries, he stays alive over and over again.

name: 13 Miedos
summary: Based on the popular 1986 Mexican program "Hora Marcada," this Spanish-language anthology series offers supernatural thrills galore. From the night watchman who's afraid of the dark to a grieving man who tries to revive his deceased wife, this inventive collection of chillers plumbs the depths of mortal terrors.

name: Skimo
summary: Skimo is the story of two boys, Fito and Tavo, who made their dreams reality by opening their own shop. Skimo is described as "the coolest place in the neighbourhood". As an eatery, Skimo sells many innovative flavoured foods, like strawberry milkshakes, mango on a stick with chamoy sauce, or the vanilla ice-cream stuffed pepper.

name: No Se Lo Digas a Nadie
summary: Deals with the real crime that occurred in the summer of 2016 in Pioz, a small town in La Alcarria, where the lifeless bodies of a Brazilian couple and their two children, 1 and 4 years old were found. Patrick, a 19-year-old nephew of the family, was the murderer and the case took on a new dimension when it was revealed that he had shared the crime via WhatsApp with his 17-year-old best friend who lived in Brazil. The details circulated among the gang of friends, thus facing the dilemma of denouncing or leaving unpunished the murder of an entire family.

name: To Ship Someone
summary: Ji Shu is the author of a melodramatic romance novel and Song Yanqi is a television producer who likes happy love stories. Both of them transmigrate in Song Yanqi's novel and end up rewriting the story, while falling in love in the process.

name: Mr. Insomnia Waiting for Love
summary: Popular musician Lu En Tong and technology firm president Song Yan Xu both suffer from chronic insomnia. They come to discover that by touching one another, sleep befalls them both in a matter of seconds.

name: Party Monsters Cabo
summary: Party Monsters Cabo is a reality TV show airing on E!. The show involves party planners competing at the LG Villa in Cabo to see who can throw the "ultimate party" for Hollywood's A-Listers to win a contract with LG for their partys. The show is hosted by Brian Worley and Michele Merkin.

name: Silos Baking Competition
summary: Home bakers travel to Waco, TX for a competition that celebrates the joy that comes from time spent in the kitchen. Competitors try to perfect a favorite recipe for a chance to have their treat featured at Magnolia's Silos Baking Co. and win $100,000.

name: Motel Rescue
summary: Lindsey Kurowski is hitting the road to help struggling motel owners across America get back on track.

name: Mevlânâ Celâleddîn-i Rûmî
summary: In 13th century Anatolia, as the Mongol threat looms and internal turmoil rages, Rumi, a wise spiritual figure, emerges to assuage people's fears. His timeless words unite reason and compassion, inspiring change.

name: Food Truck Prize Fight
summary: Denver's best food trucks battle for $10,000 and an exclusive opportunity.

name: Vgly
summary: Despite having no money, contacts, or social standing, aspiring artist Vgly and his crew strive to break into the music business.

name: Acorda, Carlo!
summary: Carlo is a wacky, fun-loving boy with a passion for cookies and adventure. But after he falls into a magically deep sleep things will never be the same;

name: My Universe
summary: My Universe is an anthology series following 12 diverse stories of love.

name: Murder Notes
summary: Wealthy individuals in Longcheng City have been dying one after another, and a dark shadow has been found at each crime scene. Fu Yaoyao, the captain of Longcheng City's criminal investigation team, and Jiang Zu'an, the deputy captain, quickly launched an investigation. With the full cooperation of the young chemist Zhong Shenhao, they exposed this shadow in broad daylight, leaving it with nowhere to hide. But little did they know, as one wave subsided, another arose.

name: Barrabrava
summary: After a fierce internal dispute, the brothers Polaco and César are expelled from the Barrabrava of Club Atlético Libertad del Puerto, where they remained under the orders of "El Tío". Unprotected and unable to count on a political power to protect them, the brothers will test their survival skills in a hostile and marginal world, while they prepare a war that will challenge their personal ties.

name: Modern Love Chennai
summary: Modern Love Chennai is an eclectic bouquet of love stories – funny, quirky, deep and puzzling. While the stories converse with your heart, you also catch a glimpse into the soul of Chennai with its unique terrains and diverse inhabitants.

name: Almania
summary: Frank Stimpel, Germany's most German teacher - correct, obsessed with rules, lactose intolerant - is finally allowed to teach at a troubled school. Everything is at stake for him now, because his teacher's exam is coming up. If he doesn't make it, that's it. The unflinching Alman has to prove himself in a world that works differently than described in his teacher's guide.

name: The Gene of AI
summary: The future is here, and a new species lives among people: humanoids. These robotic beings are highly sentient like man and suffer from unique ailments. Thankfully, Dr. Hikaru Sudo can help. He vows to treat the humanoids even by means that may be considered illegal, causing him to lead a double life. But when strange diseases emerge due to this coexistence, ethical lines become blurred.

name: The White Castle
summary: On the eve of graduation, Wang Yangming, who took reversing heart failure as his mission, had a disagreement with his supervisor in medical experiments, and resolutely decided to switch from scientific research to clinical practice, and successfully joined the emergency department of Ruiren Hospital, which ranked first in the country. Wang Yangming's competitive instinct was aroused by his busy life in the emergency department, when he took risks to deal with ventricular fibrillation in the elderly, rescued heat stroke migrant workers, treated stroke patients, and so on, constantly refined his medical skills. At the same time , on the ward formed group named "four masters of emergency medicine" , which Yang's Ming is a part, alongside with Lu Qing Qi, Zu Wen Da and Liu Fei. Now four of them, witness each other's growth and change, gain friendship and love, and experience dispersion and separation on their ward.

name: Beauty of Resilience
summary: It tells the magnificent Xianxia story of Wei Zhi, the female protagonist who is reincarnated as a phoenix, and Yan Yue, the male protagonist who is the Sun God. They go through hardships and finally break the destiny of how the "phoenix nirvana will shake the three worlds" and rewrite their own Xianxia story together.

name: The Office
summary: In The Office Australia, Hannah Howard is the managing director of packaging company Flinley Craddick.When she gets news from Head Office that they will be shutting down her branch and making everyone work from home, she goes into survival mode, making promises she can't keep in order to keep her "work family" together. The staff of Flinley Craddick indulge her and must endure Hannah's outlandish plots as they work toward the impossible targets that have been set for them.

name: Pop Britannia
summary: Pop Britannia explores our flair for pop, our fascination with finding our own pop voice and our obsession with style and the imagery of empire and nationhood.

name: Delicious in Dungeon
summary: When young adventurer Laios and his company are attacked and soundly thrashed by a dragon deep in a dungeon, the party loses all its money and provisions. They're eager to get right back to it, but there's just one problem: if they set out with no food or coin to speak of, they're sure to eat it on the way! But Laios comes up with a brilliant idea: "Let's eat the monsters!" Slimes, basilisks, mimics, and even dragons...none are safe from the appetites of these dungeon-crawling gourmands!

name: Revealed
summary: Designer and mom of two, Veronica Valencia and her team, will meet with clients to learn about their family background and meaningful moments from their past. In each episode, she'll consult with a genealogist to learn more about her clients' cultural identity and create a life-size mood board inspired by the aesthetic details of their family story. Veronica and her expert team consisting of design guru Tommy Rouse, master builder David Bohler and talented artist Joshua Smith will then transform the home, creating beautiful and modern spaces that honor the family's cultural heritage. She also will include special heirloom projects, such as artwork and artifacts, that weave the homeowners' personal legacy into the overall design.

name: Четыре жены
summary:
From the creators of the show "Four Weddings."
Couples have fumed and fumed their weddings and even decided whose celebration is better. But fading their weddings is just the beginning: now these same girls will once again enter the fray to find out who is the best wife.

name: Fenway Bowl
summary:
The Fenway Bowl is an NCAA Division I Football Bowl Subdivision college football bowl game played at Fenway Park in Boston, Massachusetts. Organized by ESPN Events and Fenway Sports Management, it features teams from the American Athletic Conference and the Atlantic Coast Conference. Upon its inaugural playing in 2022, it became the fourth active bowl game staged in a baseball stadium, along with the Pinstripe Bowl (Yankee Stadium), the Holiday Bowl (Petco Park) and Guaranteed Rate Bowl (Chase Field). 

American football games at Fenway Park date to at least 1916. Various professional and college football teams have played at Fenway, including the Boston Patriots during the American Football League (AFL) era, and the Boston College Eagles. Prior to the Fenway Bowl, no bowl game had been scheduled for the ballpark.

On December 17, 2022, as part of the 2022–23 bowl season, the Fenway Bowl was played for the first time, featuring Cincinnati and Louisville.

name: Your Brain
summary: Is what you see real? Does your mind control you? Discover how your brain really works.

name: Tokyo in April is...
summary:
As kids, Kazuma Takizawa and Ren Ishihara were the best of friends. Nearly inseparable, the two did everything together. But when they reached their third year of middle school, everything changed. Forced to move to America, Kazuma left with almost no warning, bringing his friendship with Ren to a very abrupt and unexpected end.

Ten years later, Kazuma is back in Japan and excited to begin his new job. Completely unaware that Ren is now working as the company's top designer, Kazuma is shocked to see his old friend again. Thrilled to be reunited with Ren, Kazuma hopes they'll be able to pick up where they left off, but Ren seems to want nothing to do with him. Keeping Kazuma at a friendly distance, Ren acts more like a former classmate than a former best friend.

Struggling to understand why Ren is being so cold, Kazuma decides being around Ren at work is enough. Content to have him back in his life, Ren tells himself he's happy, though deep down, he hopes to have his old friend back soon. With time, will he be able to win back the affection of his best friend and first love?

name: Ray of Light
summary: Hao Nan, a teacher who is nearing his thirties, faces a bunch of high school students who were abandoned by society and deemed as losers. He decides to help these students regain their confidence, working hand-in-hand with them to redeem themselves and create miracles. Together, they complete their high school entrance examinations, galloping toward hope and dreams.

name: Where Dreams Begin
summary:
It tells the ups and downs of a group of young people in Beijing during the 1970s, reflecting the changing times through the struggles of the "little people" and depicting the next generation amidst a wave of reform and opening up.

Xiao Chunsheng along with his two buddies Ye Guohua and Chen Hongjun, are children of military families and government workers who grew up in the same courtyard. They share many experiences like joining the army, taking the gaokao, going out to sea, and starting a business, while supporting each other the entire way. They also meet Tong Xiaomei, a Beijing girl pursuing her dreams of becoming a doctor.

name: Love Tractor
summary: Love Tractor tells the heartwarming rural love story that unfolds when Seonyul, a temporarily relocated city man, meets Yechan, a rural man who adores the countryside. Seonyul, a city man who comes to the countryside to experience life, knows nothing about farming. At that moment, Yechan, a passionate young man who loves rural life, appears before him. As Seonyul learns to adapt to rural living and engage in farming activities, he becomes increasingly attracted to Yechan's sincerity and enthusiasm. Together, these two young individuals embark on a chaotic and romantic countryside journey of healing and love.

name: Sound Candy: Your Sound That Fills Me
Jurnal Risa
summary: During a vacation trip, Risa befriends a local child named Dewi. Tragic events unfold when Dewi becomes possessed by an evil spirit in the form of a young child.

name: The Villain of Romance
summary: A coming-of-age story and realistic romance about young college "villains" who are still learning about love.

name: Nago. Głośno. Dumnie
summary: A group of Polish burlesque and drag performers. The community they create together allows them to be who they want to be and to realise any of their creations and fantasies. In their world, no one has to do anything, every body is beautiful and every love is possible. Unfortunately, this freedom comes at a price. Poland is a country that is increasingly talked about in the world in the context of racism, sexism and homophobia.

name: Kartulid ja apelsinid
summary:
"Who runs the world? Girls!" shouts the beloved pop artist in a well-known hit song, and all the women across the country cheer along: "We run this world!"

"Potatoes and Oranges" is a real-life drama series about women - emotional, frank and exciting with striking stories, about which women prefer to remain silent even in the company of best friends. Of these secret, vital and delicate stories, women are ready to spill their hearts only to the psychologist Vivian, who is the main character of "Potatoes and Oranges". In Vivian's private office, both our stories and those of our friends and acquaintances are revealed, which is very important to be a part of, because often it is the side view that helps us to assess and understand our own problems more clearly.

name: Tapie
summary: Tapie is a mini-series that traces the romantic destiny of an extraordinary character, Bernard Tapie, one of the most iconic and controversial French public figures. Throughout the seven episodes, Laurent Lafitte will step into the shoes of Bernard Tapie, exploring his rise and fall.

name: Crack Addicts
summary: With groundbreaking chiropractic methods, Dr. Alessandra Colón and her one-of-a-kind staff tackle the most extreme and debilitating physical conditions. Through every snap, crack and pop, she provides relief when no one else can.

name: 68 Ventures Bowl
summary:
The 68 Ventures Bowl is a postseason NCAA-sanctioned Division I FBS college football bowl game that has been played annually in Mobile, Alabama since 1999. In 2021, the game was moved from Ladd-Peebles Stadium to Hancock Whitney Stadium, on the campus of the University of South Alabama. The game currently matches teams from the Sun Belt Conference and the Mid-American Conference. Originally known as the Mobile Alabama Bowl during its first two playing's, it has undergone many name changes.

When the bowl first began, it was played as one of the first games of the bowl season in December. The 2006 season saw the game moved to January, and it served as one of the last bowls played before the national championship game of either the Bowl Championship Series or the College Football Playoff. For the 2015 season, the bowl was moved back to December, where it remained for every subsequent playing except for the 2019 season.

name: Sun Belt Conference Football Championship
summary:
The Sun Belt Conference Football Championship is an annual college football game that determines the season champion of the Sun Belt Conference (SBC). The game is played between the SBC regular-season divisional champions from the East and West divisions. First contested in 2018, the game is typically played on the first Saturday of December. 

In 1987, the National Collegiate Athletic Association (NCAA) approved a proposal made by two Division II conferences that allowed any conference with 12 football members to split into divisions and stage a championship game between the divisional winners, with that game not counting against NCAA limits on regular-season contests. However, the rule would not see its first use until 1992, when the Southeastern Conference, which had added Arkansas and South Carolina the previous year, launched its title game. In early 2016, NCAA legislation was passed that largely deregulated FBS conference championship games, allowing a conference with fewer than 12 teams to stage a championship game that featured either (1) the top two teams at the end of a full round-robin conference schedule, or (2) the winners of each of two divisions, with each team playing a full round-robin schedule within its division.[1] Several months later, the Sun Belt Conference announced that they would be introducing a football championship game starting in the 2018 season.

It seeks to discover exactly that, and begins where other dates end: naked! One bachelor and six candidates - the candidates are naked! They are presented in six boxes without lids and are revealed piece by piece. All the candidates have to convince themselves that the coveted single is their body because the face is only revealed at the end. What does the naked body say about personality and lifestyle?

name: The Life of Loi: Mediterranean Secrets
summary: Usher in the new year, and your health with The Life of Loi: Mediterranean Secrets, with chef, Maria Loi, of the critically acclaimed restaurant, Loi Estiatorio, in Manhattan. Known as the Julia Child of Greece, Maria shares thousands of years of knowledge baked into Mediterranean cuisine as she takes us island hopping across Greece.

name: SWAC Football Championship
summary:
The SWAC Championship, officially the Cricket Wireless SWAC Championship Game, is an American college football game that is held annually on the first Saturday in December by the Southwestern Athletic Conference (SWAC) to determine its football champion. The game pits the champion of the Eastern Division against the champion of the Western Division in a game that follows the conclusion of the regular season. From 2015 onward, the winner of the game has represented the SWAC in the Celebration Bowl. 

The game was held at Legion Field in Birmingham, Alabama, from 1999 through 2012, and moved to NRG Stadium in Houston, Texas, for the 2013 through 2017 playing's. Since 2018, the game has been played at a campus site, hosted by the participant with the higher ranking, with the exception of the 2021 spring game when the championship moved to its third neutral location at the Mississippi Veterans Memorial Stadium in Jackson, Mississippi due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

Following the 1998 season, the SWAC announced that the league would be split into two divisions with the divisional winners meeting in a championship game.

name: Contraband: Seized at the Border
summary: The border between the USA and Mexico is the busiest in the world. This series follows the work of America's Customs and Border Protection agency, whose job is to defend the border and stop terrorists, drugs and illegal weapons from entering the country.

name: Queen Dugu
summary: After their family was wrongfully persecuted due to the machinations of a corrupt official, Dugu Jia Luo held strict expectations for herself to be independent and strong even at a young age. Her husband Yang Jian is a man of great spirit. He is a warrior, skilled in battle, who rises up the ranks to become the Emperor. With Dugu Jia Luo by his side, they succeed in uniting the country under the Sui Dynasty. The husband and wife stay in a monogamous relationship despite their imperial status and come to be revered by people as the two saints due to their extraordinary contributions to a new golden age.

name: Gods of Tennis
summary:
Gods of Tennis celebrates the golden era of tennis in the 1970s and 80s; a time when cultural changes in the modern world descended on the most famous tennis tournament in the world - Wimbledon. Telling the inside story of the legendary players who transformed the game, the series features a cast of sporting geniuses; icons like Navratilova, Borg, and Evert, giving first-hand accounts of the seminal moments in their careers, at a time when a global audience was captivated by an annual Wimbledon soap opera. 

Alongside personal insight, this distinctive period is brought back to life. The series features rich cultural, political and sporting archive as global events like the cold war, the sexual revolution, race relations and the fight for LGBT rights found expression in the Wimbledon Championships, the game's most traditional sporting arena.

name: The Flame Imperial Guards
summary: Qin swan, who has always been a smooth and unrestrained man, is gradually involved in a big conspiracy about the world because of the investigation of a bizarre murder case, and at the same time unveils the mystery of his own birth that has been buried for more than twenty years. In one dangerous case investigation after another, the threat of enemies, betrayal of colleagues, and suspicion of partners do not destroy Qin's will for justice. In the end, his charisma infects his partners, and they work together to defeat the conspiracy of the mastermind behind the case to bring justice to the innocent lives lost, to bring peace to the world, to keep the kingdom of China intact, and to live up to the name of the Red Flame Guards, a name trusted by the people.

name: Blades of the Guardians
summary: The story takes place during the Sui dynasty. We follow the journey of Dao Ma, an experienced bounty hunter, accompanied by his young son Xiao Qi.

name: Miraculous Brothers
summary: An exciting mystery unfolds between Dong Joo, a hot-blooded young man who has only debts, and Kang San, an unidentified boy with mysterious abilities.

name: FreeKs
summary: The life of Gaspar, a talented musician and leader of the band FreeKs, takes an unexpected turn when his friends accuse him of a crime he did not commit. This accusation has far-reaching consequences for Gaspar. He is determined to prove his innocence and get his former life back. Gaspar goes in search of the real culprit and does everything in his power to track him down. In the meantime, Gaspar has to watch his former band grow in popularity day by day. At the same time he experiences how the remaining band members Ulises, Ludovico, Coco and Juani deal with the overwhelming success and what the pressure and contradictions of fame do to them. During their musical or truth-finding journey, they all go through a development process in which they begin to question themselves in order to find out who they are, what their fears are and who they ultimately want to be.

name: Меньшее зло
summary: After 15 years of marriage, 40-year-old Vika and Maks seem to have become one. Their ideal designer-renovated apartment is missing only one thing - a child. Everything changes one fateful evening when friend Pasha, who has returned after several years of living in Moscow, comes to visit the couple with his new acquaintance Alisa. After a few glasses of wine, Maks admits to a friend that the couple wants to have a child, but he himself cannot have children, while Vika is completely healthy. Having learned the secret of her new acquaintances, Alisa, without thinking twice, invites Pasha to become a sperm donor and help out her friends. This awkward proposal is about to change their lives forever.

name: Cattleya Killer
summary: When a young woman's body with tell-tale markings of the Cattleya Killer is found, the lives of the man who cracked the case three decades ago and his two sons are thrown into turmoil.

name: Level 1 Demon Lord and One Room Hero
summary: A hero defeats a demon in a great battle. Years later, the demon revives as a child, and finds the hero is now a loser.

name: Shadow Force
summary: A look at how a special forces unit operates as each week military specialists take on various missions around the world.

name: Liar Liar
summary: At Academy Island, everything is settled through "Games" waged for a certain number of stars, with the strongest student being granted the ranking of Seven Stars. Hiroto, a transfer student, unexpectedly beats the strongest empress and becomes the pseudo-strongest in the school! A mind game of lies and bluffs begins!

name: NBC Nightly News with Lester Holt: Kids Edition
summary: Top headlines are broken down to help kids best understand the world today.

name: The Killer Bee Catcher
summary: As killer bees invade, one man bravely protects the people, the planet...and the bees. Lance Davis risks his own life while preserving his mission: first, keep the people safe; then, save the bees.

name: Eli Roth Presents: The Legion of Exorcists
summary: Showcases stories of demonic possession from cursed objects inflicting harm to human body takeovers.

name: Factory of Dreams: Benfica
summary: Benfica, one of the elite teams in European football, also has one of the most advanced and respected academies in the world, producing world-class talent every year. This series goes behind the scenes of Benfica's modern training facilities, discovering, first-hand, the challenges that these young players face during a complete season.
